SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

2. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   C. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   D. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   C. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   C. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   C. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.

6. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   D. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.

8. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   C. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

10. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   C. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.
   D. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

12. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

13. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat The School as rumours only.
   C. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The School.

14. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   B. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   D. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   B. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   B. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   C. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain The County Governments in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Compass Direction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Location and size of the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Physical features in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Seasons in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Historic Built Environments in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
